ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark/black) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) punctate regions constituting approximately 5-8% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple high-contrast, contiguous circular white blobs (rosettes) distributed primarily in the medial and central regions of both lobes against a uniform dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression with an approximate 125-degree aperture; characterized by a secondary small V-shaped indentation located slightly to the right of the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, irregular serrations across the trailing edge, culminating in high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged clusters at the distal tips caused by biological accretion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, presenting a smooth arc-like profile on the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Symmetric clusters of small, circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (rosettes) visible across the central sections of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of brownish-white barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, altering the natural geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct secondary notch or cleft located on the trailing edge immediately adjacent to the right of the primary median notch.
